description: Generate production source code that implements story behavior using domain language and clean code principles
goal: Create clean, maintainable production code that implements story behavior using domain concepts
inputs: Failing test files, story specifications, acceptance criteria, domain language, and patterns
outputs: Source code files (.py, .js, etc.) with production implementation that makes tests pass
instructions: **STEP 0 — IDENTIFY DOMAIN NAMES (Priority 1)**
BEFORE writing any production code, declare the structure explicitly:
- Story Path: [Epic] -> [Sub-Epic] -> [Story]
- Module: src/<area>/<domain_entity_snake_case>.py (or .js)
- Class: <DomainEntity> (PascalCase domain entity from story)
- Public methods: domain responsibility verbs from acceptance criteria
- Dependencies (injected via constructor): list each collaborator
**BEHAVIOR PURPOSE:**
This behavior WRITES PRODUCTION CODE. The primary output is implementation files that make failing tests pass.
Follow the abd-clean-code skill (agilebydesign-skills/skills/abd-clean-code/SKILL.md).
**CODE MUST FOLLOW CLEAN CODE PRINCIPLES:**
- Functions: single responsibility, under 20 lines, 0-2 params, guard clauses
- Names: domain language, intention-revealing, consistent vocabulary
- Dependencies: all injected through constructor, no hidden globals
- Classes: SRP, under 200-300 lines, expose behavior not data
- Errors: domain exceptions, never swallow, isolate error handling

actions.name: build
instructions: code: render production code required to implement all tests that have been recently built or updated
Use the clean-code.py or clean-code.js template from agilebydesign-skills/skills/abd-clean-code/templates/
Declare module, class, and method names from domain language before writing code
Each class gets one module file; each function stays under 20 lines; all deps injected via constructor

actions.name: validate
instructions: code: validate source code quality and domain language usage
Validate that code uses proper domain terminology (class names = domain entities, method names = domain responsibilities)
Validate against abd-clean-code rules: function size, SRP, explicit deps, encapsulation, domain language
Validate that all source files, classes, and functions are properly mapped to story-graph.json
MANDATORY: Discover and pass code_files parameter - CodeScanner requires explicit file paths to scan for violations

trigger_words.description: Behavior-level trigger words - specific to production code generation behavior
